mentions.name: Depth Anything-assisted segment annotation tool
mentions.description: A prototype segment annotation tool assisted by the Depth Anything depth model, aimed at plant detection in non-agricultural environments where dense green vegetation makes segmentation hard, and intended to be useful for other difficult segmentation tasks.
mentions.problem: Plant detection in non-agricultural environments, where the backdrop is an endless sea of green complexity.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm prototyping a Depth Anything[1] -assisted segment annotation tool, with an eye toward plant detection in non-agriculture environments (where the backdrop is an endless sea of green complexity).
